I'll start by reading TASK.md and brief.md so I can follow the brief exactly, with Section 0 taking priority.Section 0 inherits the T3j, T5, and T6 rules. I'll read those briefs and the starting-point documents before any experiment.The shooting screen already shows a centre mark in the T6 stock shots. I'll capture stock K1 myself, including a Small target moved off centre, and record the draw calls that place it.The centre mark is four grey corners, and they stay put through S1. The dial did not land on Small, so the next run will follow the size sequence and then check whether those corners move.The shooting-screen brackets follow `0x88b2`, and the ten-byte record does not. Next I’ll check the positioner listing against the image and measure the T6 frame on the AF-ON edges.The T6 frame stays put while the ten-byte changes. The last experiment will make the shooting-screen positioner read that ten-byte while AF-ON owns it.The six experiment versions are used. The last one aborted before the session, so the display change was not run. I’m writing the records from the measurements that did complete.The shooting screen draws an AF target frame on stock K1, and that frame follows the half-press position. Under the T6 configuration it does not follow the AF-ON target.

On stock K1 the TFT shooting screen shows four grey corner marks. At rest, with `0x88b2` at 526, they occupy (417, 265) through (483, 335). After the direct screen sets Small and moves the target to 412, the same marks occupy (356, 198) through (421, 269). Holding S1 does not move them. The ten-byte record at `0xa33ca384` stays All, 27×39, at position 526 the whole time. Subject Detect `0x1e71[0]` reads back 0.

The routine that reads the live position is `0x609eec84`. It loads `0x88b2` through the settings getter and loads the kind through `0x84d1`. Kind 2 forces position 526. The listing matches the image. It does not read the ten-byte record.

With the T6 configuration reused (half-press All, mirror seeded Small at 529), an AF-ON press sets the ten-byte to Small at 529 and the owner byte to 2. `0x88b2` stays 526. The viewfinder differs from its own rest by 0 pixels, and it is byte-for-byte the same picture as K2, whose ten-byte stays All. Release, S1 alone, and S1 held with AF-ON match K2 as well. The displayed frame does not follow the AF-ON target.

The one display change was version 6 of 6. It aborted before the session opened, because the lab was imported before the E147 model was selected. The 12-edge assertions were not run, and no further version was started.

`work/result.md` and `work/evidence-manifest.json` are written. The manifest’s supplement is `work/out/manifest-supplement-t9.json`, and command 18 seals command 17 in `work/out/manifest-seal-t9.json`.
